question_text: What do you understand by vernalisation? Write its significance.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What vernalisation is
steps.margin_note: Definition with the word chilling in it. Three lines.
lines: Vernalisation is the method of inducing flowering
in plants by a period of PRE-CHILLING, that is,
steps.why: A cold requirement means the plant can only flower after a winter has passed, which is what the treatment imitates.
common_mistakes: Saying vernalisation uses heat. It uses COLD.
Saying it induces germination. It induces FLOWERING.
steps.memory_tip: Vernal means spring: cold first, flowers after.

steps.label: Its significance
steps.margin_note: One clear line on timing. Do not skip this half.

lines.text: It stops the plant flowering too early

lines: So the plant has enough time to reach maturity
steps.why: A plant that flowers before it is big enough cannot fill its seed, so the cold requirement makes sure growth comes first.
common_mistakes: Saying it speeds up flowering in every plant. It PREVENTS early flowering.
Giving no significance at all. It is a whole mark.
steps.memory_tip: Grow first, flower after: the cold enforces the order.
